description: Read-only quote of the Hyperliquid-to-Polygon Relay return route, including collateral headroom, expected owner-wallet credit, all-in cost, and estimated duration. This legacy owner-wallet quote is separate from allocated-capital Relay returns to Arc Home; use preview_capital_move and start_capital_move for those. This bounded read never creates an operation, requests a signature, submits an order, or moves money.

account_id.description: Optional owned child account UUID. Omit for the active account.

amount_usd.description: Hyperliquid USDC amount to quote, from $1 through $200.

venue.description: Source venue. crypto and hyperliquid are equivalent.

name: preview_return_route
